messages.subject: options for group comparisons
parts:
Hi,

Thank you for making this wonderful program. i am very new to this analysis, and need to learn, so I will probably ask naive questions.

i would like to do a group comparison on model parameters but with covariates (e.g., age) and maybe linear regression with continuous variables for reversal learning task. Could you direct me to the best approach to learn or resources for this? Or do you have functions already built into hbayesdm to do these analyses?

Thanks in advance.

messages.author: 4bcf82a01cf98f56
messages.subject: Re: options for group comparisons
parts:
Hi,

I've done it in the following paper (Vassileva et al 2013 Plos One; please see Appendix S3) but it requires some modification of a model, which will take some decent amount of time and effort. For that reason, controlling for a covariate is not currently possible in the hBayesDM package and I don't have any plan to include such a function in the near future...

http://journals.plos.org/plosone/article?id=10.1371/journal.pone.0068962

Sorry,
Young
